memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: From the hilltop the boundary headed toward the spring of the waters of Nephtoah, came out at the towns of Mount Ephron and went down toward Baalah (that is, Kiriath Jearim). Then it curved westward from Baalah to Mount Seir, ran along the northern slope of Mount Jearim (that is, Kesalon), continued down to Beth Shemesh and crossed to Timnah. It went to the northern slope of Ekron, turned toward Shikkeron, passed along to Mount Baalah and reached Jabneel. The boundary ended at the sea - Josh 15:9-11 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Springs, hilltops, slopes, towns — the boundary of Judah is traced past one landmark after another until it finally reaches the sea. Every feature of the landscape is known and named. God's mapping of His people's inheritance is astonishingly detailed, down to individual springs and the shoulders of particular hills.

We may not know these places, but the God who dictated this boundary knew every one intimately. This is a picture of how thoroughly God knows the terrain of our lives. Not a single feature escapes His notice — not the high places of joy, not the low slopes of struggle, not the hidden springs of hope. He knows it all, down to the smallest detail.

Jesus taught this same truth in tender terms: even the hairs of our head are numbered, and not a sparrow falls without the Father's knowledge (Matt 10:29-30). The God who mapped Judah's inheritance spring by spring is the God who maps our days with the same care. Nothing about your life is unknown to Him or beyond His attention. When you feel overlooked, remember that the God of infinite detail has not lost track of a single landmark in your story.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you believe God knows the smallest details of your life?
- Which "landmark" in your current season do you need to trust God sees?
- How does God's detailed knowledge of you bring comfort rather than fear?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Lord, You know every detail of my life, down to the smallest landmark. When I feel overlooked, remind me that nothing about me escapes Your loving attention. Amen.
